title: LookupBot environment
description: Security-aware schema generated from static configuration metadata.

DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Discord bot token from the Developer Portal.

DISCORD_GUILD_ID.description: Discord server ID to which the bot is locked.

DISCORD_ALLOWED_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated allowlist of support and test channel IDs.

DISCORD_CMI_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs routed to the CMI context.

DISCORD_JOBS_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs routed to the Jobs context.

DISCORD_SVIS_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs routed to the SVIS context.

DISCORD_MFM_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs routed to the MFM context.

DISCORD_TRYME_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs routed to the TryMe context.

DISCORD_TRADEME_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs routed to the TradeMe context.

DISCORD_RESIDENCE_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs routed to the Residence context.

DISCORD_BOTTLEDEXP_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Comma-separated channel IDs routed to the BottledExp context.

DISCORD_CMI_TEST_CHANNEL_IDS.description: Legacy fallback for test channel IDs.

DISCORD_TEST_DEFAULT_CONTEXT.description: Plugin context used by test channels until overridden.

ALLOWED_ROLE_IDS.description: Comma-separated role IDs allowed to use lookup commands.

ADMIN_ROLE_IDS.description: Comma-separated role IDs allowed to use admin commands.

AI_ROLE_IDS.description: Comma-separated role IDs allowed to use AI-backed options. Required when OPENAI_ENABLED=true; otherwise falls back to ADMIN_ROLE_IDS.

DISCORD_ADMIN_ALERT_CHANNEL_ID.description: Private channel that receives aggregate data-health alerts.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. Required when OPENAI_ENABLED=true.

OPENAI_MODEL.description: OpenAI model used for reranking and summaries.

DISPLAY_PATH_PREFIX.description: Prefix shown before repository-relative lookup paths.

CACHE_LOAD_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum number of cache profiles loaded concurrently.

SEARCH_RESULT_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES.description: Maximum repeated-search results retained in the in-memory LRU cache; zero disables it.

SOURCE_LINKS_ENABLED.description: Link lookup results to the exact deployed source revision.

SOURCE_REPOSITORY_URL.description: Public HTTPS GitHub repository used for pinned source links.

PAGINATION_TTL_MINUTES.description: Minutes before interactive result controls expire.

PAGINATION_MAX_RESULTS.description: Maximum ranked results retained per interactive session.

SEARCH_SYNONYMS_PATH.description: Repository-relative path to plugin-scoped search synonyms.

VERSION_CHECK_MAX_ATTEMPTS.description: Maximum attempts for a temporary upstream failure.

VERSION_CHECK_RETRY_BASE_MS.description: Initial upstream retry delay in milliseconds.

VERSION_CHECK_RETRY_MAX_MS.description: Maximum upstream retry delay in milliseconds.

VERSION_CHECK_CIRCUIT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD.description: Consecutive failed refreshes before a resource circuit opens.

VERSION_CHECK_CIRCUIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.description: Cooldown before an open resource circuit permits a recovery probe.

COMMAND_USER_RATE_LIMIT.description: Commands allowed per user in each rate window.

COMMAND_CHANNEL_RATE_LIMIT.description: Commands allowed per channel in each rate window.

COMMAND_GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT.description: Commands allowed globally in each rate window.

RATE_LIMIT_AUDIT_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.description: Coalescing window for repeated rate-limit audit entries.

ADMIN_ALERT_REMINDER_HOURS.description: Hours before repeating an unchanged alert.

CLEAN_DATA_STALE_HOURS.description: Maximum clean-snapshot age before an alert.

UPSTREAM_CHECK_STALE_HOURS.description: Maximum upstream-check age before an alert.

QUERY_BLOCKLIST.description: Comma-separated exact queries rejected as too broad.

QUERY_ALLOWLIST.description: Comma-separated short queries exempt from minimum length.

QUERY_DEBUG_ERRORS.description: Expose detailed validation reasons to users.

AUDIT_LOG_MAX_SIZE_MB.description: Maximum active audit-log size before rotation.

SERVICE_LOG_MAX_SIZE_MB.description: Maximum size of each active structured service-log stream.

SERVICE_LOG_MAX_FILES.description: Maximum archives retained for each service-log stream.

SERVICE_LOG_MIN_FREE_MB.description: Minimum free disk reserve below which service logs stop growing.

METRICS_LOG_INTERVAL_MINUTES.description: Interval for privacy-safe aggregate metrics snapshots; use 0 to disable periodic snapshots.
